title: Hot Sauces
summary: Explore 75 famous, unusual, and fiercely hot sauces, including pepper oils and chili crisps from around the world.
dataNote: Scoville scores are published sauce measurements where available. Values marked on a card as pepper-based or estimated use a featured pepper's rating or a documented range because finished-sauce heat varies by recipe and batch. Flavor grades are Burrow editorial assessments of balance, complexity, and versatility, not laboratory results.
